implementation_strategy: Execute preregistered controlled-fault paired protocol via adapter hosted_netops_validator_feedback_repair_v2 using deterministic_netops_fault_injector_v1 to produce one shared faulty candidate per task and two matched repair episodes (baseline blind repair; guarded validator-guided repair). All model calls via hosted openai_responses gpt-5-mini; instrument and archive all model-call metadata, verifier and simulator traces, pre/post configs, diffs, and hashes.
public_resources: preregistered controlled vendor-CLI task bank (public templates)
task_manifest_strategy: Use preregistered deterministic task indices 1..40 from the frozen controlled-fault injector; one shared faulty candidate per index.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use blind_controlled_fault_repair_v2 for baseline and validator_guided_controlled_fault_repair_v2 for guarded; record transformation inputs/outputs tokenized.
execution_batches: batch_1: tasks 1..40 single confirmatory run matching adapter contract
randomisation_plan: No outcome-dependent randomisation; fault_assignment deterministic (seed=17) as preregistered.
caching_plan: No local GPU caching; rely on hosted-model provider caching per provider policy; record cache-hits in manifest.
failure_recovery_plan: If adapter contract cannot be satisfied at runtime, abort per preregistered stopping_rule and record cause; allowed technical retries only per frozen retry policy for infrastructure failures; no human retries.
estimated_compute_notes: Total model-call budget = 120 (40 tasks * up to 3 calls). Use hosted openai_responses gpt-5-mini; no local GPU. Wall-clock runtime expected <7 days per manifest; instrument token counts and elapsed time per call.
